steps.sql: SELECT tu.UserName AS UserName, tu.UserID AS UserID, tu.emailId AS emailId, tu.ext AS Extension, dp.your_number AS From_Number, tch.customerNumber AS To_Number, ROUND(tch.callDuration / 1000) AS `Call_Duration(sec)`, tcdh.createdAt AS Called_Time FROM tb_CallHistory tch JOIN tb_CallDurationHistory tcdh ON tch.CallHistoryId = tcdh.CallHistoryId JOIN tb_User tu ON tu.UserID = tcdh.AgentId LEFT JOIN did_purchase dp ON dp.user_id = tu.ext AND dp.domainId = tch.domainId WHERE tch.domainId = :domainId ORDER BY tcdh.createdAt DESC
